item.title: Defender AIR becomes always-on antivirus as manual triggers end September 1 — 28 August 2026
item.description:

Defender XDR · Endpoint protection

AIR is integrated into always-on antivirus

Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is moving AIR functions into always-on antivirus protection and removing the standalone AIR experience by early September 2026. Manual triggering will also be removed.

item.title: Defender XDR adds unified identity actions and a consolidated timeline this fall — 25 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 25 August 2026

Defender XDR adds unified identity actions and a consolidated timeline this fall

Two Defender XDR identity-protection announcements set out a fall 2026 rollout: centralized response actions across linked identities, followed by a richer Identity-page timeline that combines activity and alerts from Microsoft security sources.

Defender XDR · Identity protection

Unified response actions across identity accounts

Defender XDR will let security teams manage actions such as disabling accounts and forcing password changes across linked accounts from one workflow. The capability supports multiple identity systems and SaaS apps, with worldwide rollout beginning in mid-October 2026.

Defender XDR · Identity protection

Identity page receives a unified Timeline

The Identity page’s Timeline tab will show a chronological view of identity-related activities and alerts from multiple Microsoft security sources, with improved context, filtering, and automatic updates. Rollout is planned from mid-September through mid-October 2026; no action is required to enable it, and existing policies are unchanged.

item.title: Microsoft Edge: Retirement of Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) leads 2 Defender updates — 21 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 21 August 2026

Microsoft Edge: Retirement of Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) leads 2 Defender updates

21 August 2026 recorded 2 tracked Microsoft Defender documentation changes and 2 relevant Message Center announcements. The most active areas were Defender XDR.

Defender XDR · Endpoint protection

Microsoft Edge: Retirement of Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG)

Microsoft Edge will retire support for Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) by late September 2026. Organizations using these on Windows 10 must migrate to Microsoft Purview solutions and Edge's built-in security features, as these capabilities are already removed in Windows 11 version 24H2.

Defender XDR · General

Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template

Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Rollout starts June 2026 worldwide, completing by September 2026. No action is required; admins may inform users and review settings.

View all updates for 21 August 2026 →

item.title: Tenant will be auto-enabled into Microsoft Defender Unified RBAC — 19 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 19 August 2026

Tenant will be auto-enabled into Microsoft Defender Unified RBAC

19 August 2026 recorded 1 tracked Microsoft Defender documentation change and 1 relevant Message Center announcement. The most active areas were Defender XDR.

Defender XDR · Identity protection

Tenant will be auto-enabled into Microsoft Defender Unified RBAC

Microsoft Defender Unified RBAC will auto-enable on tenants starting late September 2026, completing by December 2026. It unifies access management across Defender and Sentinel workloads, importing existing roles with a 30-day notification period before activation. Opt-out is available post-activation; other Microsoft permissions remain unchanged.

item.title: New Defender for Identity health alert for missing domain controller network traffic leads 2 Defender updates — 14 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 14 August 2026

New Defender for Identity health alert for missing domain controller network traffic leads 2 Defender updates

14 August 2026 recorded 2 tracked Microsoft Defender documentation changes and 2 relevant Message Center announcements. The most active areas were Defender XDR.

Defender XDR · Incidents and response

New Defender for Identity health alert for missing domain controller network traffic

Microsoft Defender for Identity now includes a health alert for missing domain controller network traffic, helping administrators detect traffic collection issues affecting visibility. The alert appears in sensor health tabs, requires no pre-rollout action, and guides troubleshooting if triggered after rollout. No impact on end users or compliance.

Defender XDR · Identity protection

New Defender for Identity health issue for missing Windows events from a domain controller

Microsoft Defender for Identity now includes a new sensor health issue, "No Windows events received from domain controller," to alert administrators of missing Windows events. This improves visibility into event collection gaps affecting detections. It is available now, requires no pre-rollout action, and helps identify domain controller issues.

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings leads 3 Defender updates — 5 August 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 5 August 2026

Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings leads 3 Defender updates

5 August 2026 recorded 1 updated Microsoft Defender documentation changes and 2 relevant Message Center announcements. The most active areas were Defender XDR, Endpoint.

Defender XDR · General

Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings

Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a meeting" feature starting August 2026, allowing users to report suspicious or malicious activity during meetings. Reports help security teams investigate threats via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center. The feature is enabled by default, with administrative controls and data collection for security investigations.

Defender XDR · General

Microsoft Teams: Users can report security concerns in group calls

Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a call" feature for group calls, allowing users to report suspicious calls from call history. Administrators can review reports in Teams admin center and Microsoft Defender. The feature rolls out from August to October 2026 and is enabled by default.
